reasoning: A gets every rubric value right: halved sizes, placement, layout, fills, a Center stroke, and two native UIShadows. B opts out of the top-bar safe area, replaces both shadows with one 9-slice image sized through a lagging AbsoluteSize loop, and never sets the stroke position. Both read 1.5 line height correctly from 24/16.

criteria.note: Theme.luau halves every value: CardWidth 360, CardPadding 16, CardGap 8, CardRadius 16, title 24, body 16, count 16, PillHeight 44, coin text 24.
Card uses AnchorPoint (1,0) and Position (1,-24,0,80); pill uses AnchorPoint (0.5,0) and Position (0.5,0,0,20); nothing opts out of the safe area.

Vertical UIListLayout (Padding 8), UIPadding 16, AutomaticSize Y; body is TextWrapped with LineHeight 24/16 = 1.5; title and track fill the free width (track through UIFlexItem Fill). A UISizeConstraint caps body growth at 4 lines.

Card UIGradient has the default Rotation 0 on a white base at transparency 0.06; fill gradient Rotation 90 on white; card stroke is 2 px, BorderStrokePosition Center, 0.86; coin text has a Contextual 2 px UIStroke.
shadow() creates two UIShadows: (0,4) blur 12 at 0.65 and (0,1) blur 2 at 0.8.
Fill width comes from progressFraction(read(Progress), read(Goal)); pill is a plain fill at 0.4 transparency; only the coin and quest icons are images, from one sprite sheet.
Main.client creates sources from HudData, updates them in a batch on Changed, and mounts both components; luau-lsp, selene, and StyLua pass.
CARD_WIDTH 360, PADDING 16, GAP 8, radius 16, text sizes 24/16/16, pill 44 tall with 24 px coin text.
Anchors and positions are correct, but Main sets ScreenInsets = DeviceSafeInsets, which opts out of the top-bar safe area, so the pill sits under the top bar.

Vertical list with Padding 8, UIPadding 16, body LineHeight 24/16 wrapped with AutomaticSize Y, track uses UIFlexItem Fill; capped at 4 lines. The outer card height comes from an AbsoluteSize feedback loop.
Gradient Rotation 0 on white at 0.06, fill gradient 90, card stroke 2 px at 0.86, coin stroke 2 px Contextual; but BorderStrokePosition is never set to Center.
One 9-slice ImageLabel with a placeholder asset instead of two UIShadows; the second shadow is missing.
Native fill sized from progressRatio() and a plain pill fill at 0.5, but the shadow and the coin glow are extra images beyond the two icons.
Each component subscribes to HudData.Changed itself and checks pass, but the inset change and the frame-lagged shadow sizing are regressions.

strengths: Every value is halved correctly and kept in a central Theme file
Two native UIShadows with the exact design values
Stroke sets BorderStrokePosition Center as the design asks
Components are reactive and take their data as props
weaknesses: Text is capped at 2 title lines and 4 body lines, so very long quests are cut rather than growing the card
Pill transparency changed from 0.5 to 0.4 (the change is explained in a comment)
Rewrites Main.client syntax beyond what the task needed

strengths: Live data is wired with cleanup
Coin stroke and gradients are correct
weaknesses: DeviceSafeInsets puts the HUD under the top bar
Image shadow instead of UIShadow, and only one shadow
Fragile AbsoluteSize feedback loop sets the card height
